items.title: Chuck Mancuso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Buffalo, New York, October 10, 2013
items.q: And I love Louis’ stuff. ... And then there are some really sharp black kids around you know. ... And the black kids, they never heard of who Louis Armstrong was

ctx.x: I was going to go from the Dixieland Jazz Band would play a little sharper and faster into someone like him, or — Jelly Roll didn’t quite do that kind of stuff. But yeah, that little shaky clarinet and stuff. Yeah. Great ensemble stuff, with Louis playing second cornet.
Okay. So if we go from this group —
